name: Montage Healdsburg
positioning: Bungalow-style resort near Healdsburg on 258 acres of oak trees and rolling vineyards, and Montage International's first Northern California property
best_for: Travelers planning winery visits who want help arranging tastings and private drivers
Couples wanting private patios with fire pits and outdoor showers
Families wanting kids programming and a separate family pool

facts.text: The resort is set on 258 acres with moss-covered California oak trees, surrounded by rolling vineyards.
Montage Healdsburg is the first Northern California property for Montage International.
The guest buildings are freestanding modern bungalows with one or two units per building.
One-third of each guest space is dedicated to outdoor living.
Hazel Hill serves California cuisine with a light French touch.
Scout Field Bar serves innovative cocktails.
Hudson Springs Bar and Grill serves fresh seafood seasonally.
The grab-and-go Healdsburg Country Store serves coffee from Healdsburg roaster Black Oak.
Spa Montage offers outdoor yoga classes surrounded by vineyards.
The resort has kids programming, lots of outdoor space and a separate family pool.
The in-room amenity line is created in partnership with clean, vegan brand Gloss Moderne.
The resort has house e-bikes for guests.

highlights.text: The structures were built in a way that preserved 22,000 of the property's pre-existing oak trees.
Rooms have expansive cantilevered patios with private fire pits.
Bathrooms open out onto a huge outdoor shower.
Montage has relationships with nearby wineries and can help plan visits, set up bespoke tastings and provide private drivers.
The spa is adjacent to the zero-edge outdoor pool and a full-service salon.

considerations.text: Downtown Healdsburg is about 4 miles south of the property.
WhataHotel notes the remote wine country location requires transportation planning.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.

sources.title: Conde Nast Traveler: Montage Healdsburg review
